message:
The other day, while we were packing our go-bags for a little family camping trip, I stumbled upon the emergency contact list I had made last year. You know, the one that I was feeling pretty smug about when I shared it at our last family gathering? I couldn't help but chuckle at my past self's foresight. It felt oddly satisfying to know that we had all our important documents and numbers handy without a last-minute scramble. 

Sometimes, these little preparedness moments sneak up on us, reminding us of the value of planning ahead. Have you ever had a similar 'I told you so' moment when it comes to being prepared? We'd love to hear your stories!
